def solution():
    # Define variables
    retained_earnings_2016 = 110
    retained_earnings_2017 = 125
    dividends = 8
    impairment_expense = 12

    accounts_receivable_2016 = 45
    accounts_receivable_2017 = 48
    inventory_2016 = 24
    inventory_2017 = 20
    accounts_payable_2016 = 30
    accounts_payable_2017 = 33

    # Calculate net income from retained earnings
    net_income = retained_earnings_2017 - retained_earnings_2016 + dividends

    # Calculate changes in working capital
    change_in_accounts_receivable = -(accounts_receivable_2017 - accounts_receivable_2016)
    change_in_inventory = -(inventory_2017 - inventory_2016)
    change_in_accounts_payable = accounts_payable_2017 - accounts_payable_2016

    # Calculate operating cash flow using the indirect method
    operating_cash_flow = (
        net_income
        + impairment_expense
        + change_in_accounts_receivable
        + change_in_inventory
        + change_in_accounts_payable
    )

    # Return answer to one decimal place
    return round(operating_cash_flow, 1)
